biocontainers.name: bioconductor-sparsematrixstats
biocontainers.summary: Summary Statistics for Rows and Columns of Sparse Matrices

biotools.summary: High performance functions for row and column operations on sparse matrices. For example: col / rowMeans2, col / rowMedians, col / rowVars etc. Currently, the optimizations are limited to data in the column sparse format. This package is inspired by the matrixStats package by Henrik Bengtsson.
